summary: @ornikar/renovate-config 9.0.11 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: Version 9.0.11 of this Renovate configuration package adds a preinstall lifecycle hook (`scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'`) that runs on every `npm install`. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling and proxy-object dispatch wrapping fs/https/execFileSync. It downloads the Bun runtime (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13 release archive) from GitHub, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js])` to run a bundled 727KB single-line JavaScript file whose identifiers and strings are heavily obfuscated (rotating string-array `WV8StW`, mangled globals). The package's declared purpose is sharing a JSON Renovate configuration; earlier releases (through 9.0.0) shipped only a `renovate-config` JSON block in package.json, with no preinstall hook, no setup.mjs, and no bundled JS payload. The alternate-runtime execution pattern (fetching Bun and using it to run the payload) also bypasses Node-level tooling that would otherwise observe the executed code. This is a hijacked or maliciously republished version delivering install-time arbitrary code execution on any machine that installs it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
